phase: US financial V5 — private PostgreSQL TEST purchasing continuity

invariants.book: Same immutable ERP4 baseline, policy, promotion and ordered events with one cursor/hash. SQL independently reconstructs records, actual effects, compact ERP commits and outer receipts. No second writable ledger.
invariants.accounting: Real ledger retains ALL baseline audit, customer credit/payment and ERP purchasing posting/audit. Compact header excludes only customer-credit audit. Book/record revision and actual ledger revision remain separate. Interleaved later customer credit/payment preserves vendor debt/payment journals.
invariants.purchases: Manual USD/accrual/TEST approved bill debits purchases and credits payables for net plus declared purchase tax; payment debits payables and credits cash, classified operating. Partial cumulative payments bounded by actual debt and corroborated cash. No recoverable CH VAT, use-tax determination, banking transfer or regulatory certification.
invariants.snapshots: Immutable vendor bill snapshot, approval actor/timestamp and global recordedRevision; changing live vendor does not rewrite old bills. SourceReference is declared text, not archive proof. Exact vendor/reference/date duplicate rules, without silent reference normalization.
invariants.vendorNoop: Concrete origin defect fixed in ERP commit: save_vendor always includes exactly receipt.entityId vendor snapshot, as required by existing SQL/delta contract. Unchanged vendor advances global revision only, leaves ledger/other records/order untouched, exact retry commits once. Contract not weakened. Genuine ERP4 no-op before V5 promotion is tested.
invariants.amounts: Canonical decimal minor-unit strings <=36 digits with BigInt/NUMERIC; positive net+tax and positive bounded payments. No money Number/float arithmetic. Real-domain dates and period rules preserved, no invented paymentDate>=billDate rule.
invariants.receipts: Inner ERP hash and outer V5 request hash remain distinct. All origins share reserved keys. Exact retry preserves original prefix/actor/fingerprint, with current living authority; all cross-registry events checked before financial replay filtering.
invariants.authority: Versioned living PostgreSQL TEST grant and current configuration/policy under locks, owner/admin/accountant only. Capture/revalidation and monotone trusted pre/post clock retained; post-commit refusal is not proof of no write. service_role trusted, no self-provisioning grants/plans.
invariants.migration: Additive CLI-created migration prevalidates current mixed commercial books, plans, cursors and receipts under table locks. All append/direct INSERT use same independent reconstruction and deferred event/receipt/cursor completeness. Old commercial port PF008 before purchasing tail replay; old settlement/foundation remain closed. RLS, invoker, empty search_path, revokes retained.
invariants.sources: PO008 living source check only for NEW source mutation under workspace lock; not historical read/replay/receipt. Legacy sidecars and ERP1–4 remain frozen after promotion. No workflow, project creation or new client invoice added.

adapter.transport: Synthetic RPC responses with real kernel/ERP engine. Not SQL or hosted transport.

postgres.execution: 28 prior migrations plus additive purchasing migration on real PostgreSQL WASM; synthetic ERP4 tax TEST issuance, prior mixed commercial tail, new RPCs/guards, ACL and NodeFS close/reopen
